title: Eldridge Triumphant

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I don't know. The shame... how can I face my peers? My adoring public? My butler?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. The shame... how can I face my peers? My adoring public? My butler?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: He DIDN'T! Poggy for Mayor? Ha ha! How sordid. I feel better already. Did anything else occur?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He DIDN'T! Poggy for Mayor? Ha ha! How sordid. I feel better already. Did anything else occur?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ha ha! Typical Minty! You know, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha! Typical Minty! You know, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Too bad. Still, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad. Still, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: How can you think of such a thing? Fine, take this. It's all I can offer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can you think of such a thing? Fine, take this. It's all I can offer.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: THAT is a first edition of POMP & FRIPPERY. Worth a lot of Lims to the right person. But of course, you wouldn't know that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THAT is a first edition of POMP & FRIPPERY. Worth a lot of Lims to the right person. But of course, you wouldn't know that.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I promised you a reward didn't I? Here: take this fashion zine. It has been my most treasured possession in this dismal place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I promised you a reward didn't I? Here: take this fashion zine. It has been my most treasured possession in this dismal place.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: And I will drown my sorrows with, damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I will drown my sorrows with, damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: TELL me you're here to put an end to my suffering. I simply can't take another day of this place. The sea hurts my eyes. Even the sand mocks me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: TELL me you're here to put an end to my suffering. I simply can't take another day of this place. The sea hurts my eyes. Even the sand mocks me.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Then it's all over for me. The end of Eldridge. I must live out my years as an eternal pariah, chained to that horrid Razlo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then it's all over for me. The end of Eldridge. I must live out my years as an eternal pariah, chained to that horrid Razlo.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Drown my sorrows, I suppose. With a... damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Drown my sorrows, I suppose. With a... damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You GOT them? Praise gold and all that's branded. How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You GOT them? Praise gold and all that's branded. How?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: How horrible. But I am ETERNALLY in your debt. The word of Eldridge is always good and I promised a reward. There.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How horrible. But I am ETERNALLY in your debt. The word of Eldridge is always good and I promised a reward. There.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: This is Tier 4 business permit from one of my old businesses, valid even for places in the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is Tier 4 business permit from one of my old businesses, valid even for places in the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh yes, I have a few. Can't quite remember how many. Anyway, it's the least I can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes, I have a few. Can't quite remember how many. Anyway, it's the least I can do.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Really, it's the least I can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really, it's the least I can do.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Then perhaps I'll see you in the Spire. It's Bo Bo's birthday soon. Maybe we'll have a party...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then perhaps I'll see you in the Spire. It's Bo Bo's birthday soon. Maybe we'll have a party...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe it's time to go back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe it's time to go back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe it's time to go back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe it's time to go back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: At least you didn't run for mayor like PorridgeDog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At least you didn't run for mayor like PorridgeDog.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: At least you didn't run for mayor like PorridgeDog.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: At least you didn't run for mayor like PorridgeDog.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not that I know of.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not that I know of.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Minty had a fling with a FLAVR unit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Minty had a fling with a FLAVR unit.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Minty had a fling with a FLAVR unit.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Minty had a fling with a FLAVR unit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A fashion zine? That's it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A fashion zine? That's it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks. I'll... treasure it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. I'll... treasure it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A zine? That's it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A zine? That's it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Looks like it's your lucky day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like it's your lucky day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Looks like it's your lucky day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Looks like it's your lucky day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No photos, sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No photos, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Afraid so. Now about my reward...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Afraid so. Now about my reward...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Afraid so. Now about my reward...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Afraid so. Now about my reward...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I gave Razlo something he wanted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I gave Razlo something he wanted.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I gave Razlo something he wanted.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I gave Razlo something he wanted.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "There" what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "There" what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "One" of your businesses...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "One" of your businesses...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're out of exile?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're out of exile?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck.
